name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
size_note: Sizes are as published on each card: download size, GPU memory or a single file. GiB figures are converted to GB. Engram, routed experts and other components may be reported separately; each row says which size it is.
pin_note: Cards are fetched at pinned Hugging Face commit revisions and their exact bytes are checked by SHA-256. Source links identify the captured revision.
coverage_note: 136 repositories discovered (130 tagged and six supplemental); 133 cards captured, three gated repositories inaccessible. Unreviewed cards and unresolved claims are explicitly held; off-site-only and image-only claims may be absent.
